name: git-fit-geo-detect
description: GitHub Action for detecting administrative divisions via git fit geo detect

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/save.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/save.js && esbuild src/shared.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/shared.cjs
scripts.build:check: npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist/index.js dist/save.js dist/shared.cjs
